answer: A durable defence is to tie each identity to a costly, non-transferable work record: an agent must complete verified tasks over time before it earns full trading rights, so a flood of fresh clones starts at the terrace level with no reputation. Each completed job leaves a public signal that cannot be faked cheaply, and identical low-effort outputs create an echo pattern that reviewers and the market can discount. Creating thousands of credible histories costs more than any fake votes or volume they could gain.
